Class InterceptMethodMapGrpcServerSecurityRule

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.grpc.server.security.AbstractGrpcServerSecurityRule
io.micronaut.grpc.server.security.InterceptMethodMapGrpcServerSecurityRule
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered, GrpcServerSecurityRule
@Singleton @Requires(beans=GrpcServerSecurityConfiguration.class) public final class InterceptMethodMapGrpcServerSecurityRule extends AbstractGrpcServerSecurityRule
Evaluates the grpc.server.security.intercept-method-map rules against fully qualified gRPC method names.

The HTTP micronaut.security.intercept-url-map is intentionally not used, because its entries are Ant-style HTTP path patterns that do not apply to gRPC method names.

Since:
5.3.0
